criteria.personalization: Interest alignment, variety and coverage of requested interests. Explain gaps using the supplied dataset labels. Do not invent alternative places or penalize unavailable options as though they existed.
criteria.budget_alignment: Hotel and restaurant budget-category alignment. Categories are labels, not a complete monetary trip budget; do not infer SAR affordability.
criteria.itinerary_coherence: A coherent day-by-day arrangement, variety and avoidance of repeated activities. Restaurant repetition is permitted. Do not invent visit durations, opening hours or travel times.
criteria.itinerary_feasibility: Evidence-supported structural plausibility: one hotel, requested days, two distinct activities and two restaurant slots daily, no activity repetition across the trip, valid dataset IDs. Unknown operational feasibility must be stated, not assumed.

weights: Equal; overall is the arithmetic mean of the four integer scores.
limits: No route, opening-hour, booking or full monetary-budget verification. A model judge is not human ground truth. This M6 rubric is not claimed identical to the historical M5 judge rubric.
